issuer.summary: PRIME's own issuer is Hastra (Signum Ltd.), which is unregulated — the SEC registration a reader is likely to notice belongs to Figure Certificate Company, the entity underneath the wrapper. FCC is a genuine full reporting registrant, KPMG-audited with a clean annual opinion and 100.3% ICA §28 coverage, its parent listed on Nasdaq as FIGR. Two limits hold this below the top of the range: the interim going-concern conclusion depends on parent support rather than standing alone, and the issuer can freeze holder balances. See the full report for the audit scope, reserve proofs and freeze authorities.

facts: ⚠️ THE REGISTRATION IS ONE LAYER DOWN. This axis scores Figure Certificate Company; PRIME's own issuer is Hastra (Signum Ltd.), UNREGULATED. A reader seeing 'SEC registrant, KPMG-audited' is reading about the asset underneath the wrapper, not the wrapper they hold.
✅ Figure Certificate Company is a full SEC reporting registrant: 10-K/10-Q with officer certifications, KPMG-audited since 2024, clean opinion, no going-concern qualification, no material weakness.
✅ Investment Company Act §28 requires qualified assets above the certificate reserve plus minimum capital. FCC disclosed 100.3% coverage at 2026-03-31.
✅ Parent Figure Technology Solutions trades on Nasdaq as FIGR.

⚠️ The clean audit opinion covers only the ANNUAL statements. The interim filing's going-concern conclusion is CONDITIONAL ON PARENT SUPPORT — a commitment letter to pay invoices and periodically forgive intercompany balances — not an independent conclusion.
⚠️ The issuer can FREEZE holder balances: mint and freeze authorities are program PDAs post-init, with freeze administrable by up to five admins. Program upgrade sits behind a Squads v4 multisig.
✅ Live proof-of-reserves at hastra.io/proof-of-reserves shows wYLDS 100.31% backed, with Provenance-chain reserve wallets independently verifiable.

✅ Two audit firms have covered the stack: Informal Systems (Solana vault-mint/stake, Nov 2025 — 1 Critical plus a vault-inflation follow-up) and Sherlock (Solana + Ethereum full stack and the cross-chain price path, Apr 2026 — 0 Critical / 0 High, 2 Medium resolved, 2 Medium accepted).

⚠️ NOT priced on this axis: PRIME is predominantly a collateral asset and the systemic-leverage question is recorded on Structural, per this desk's rule that the Liquidity axis scores observed depth only.

⚠️ PROCESS NOTE, kept because it explains a past divergence: this score was published for months with no internal source — tidresearch's 6.5 had no upstream and PegTracker independently hardcoded 5.5, a value matching no published figure. tidresearch remains the authoring surface; the two must move together.
